change: Disputed constraints retain both assessors and citation sets; unsupported opposition stays unknown.
Objective page/passages are fairly allocated; unusable searches and context overflow are prevented and disclosed.
AND required premises, OR alternatives, signed refutation and ancestor-status checks prevent support laundering.
Full immutable objection events survive summary limits and require an explicit reviewed disposition.
Exact owner attestations bind target/evidence hashes and publish a new report without inference; source-wide verification is never inferred.
Requirement/exception passage selection covers document tails, retains exact spans/hashes and records uninspected coverage.
Mandatory finishing envelopes, capacity priority and optional cutoffs apply before waiting or retrying.
Persistent not_before and immutable dispatch-generation capture fence premature/stale duplicate messages.
Start, clarification and retry use one transactional queue-capacity guard.
Canonical UTF-8 admission, conservative contribution footprints and post-research initial caps reserve final-review context.
Browser consumes event pages through the original snapshot cutoff, deduplicates and fences stale reads.
Intake sees selected passages without prematurely freezing them; typed proposed changes require explicit confirmation.
Schema repair receives bounded validation codes/paths and stage-specific repair instructions.
Hashed exact finding/decision bundles reach actual image edit and critic requests.
Production/study share versioned stage, issue, reserve and correction policies; fixed-input study adapters and optional revisions are explicitly identified.
Server-owned regression matrices preserve missing/contradictory dispositions and ancestry; old reviews have append-only recovery.
Substantive fingerprints reject title/ID aliases; paired measurement retains failures, repeats and uncertainty.
